name: rebuild-button
about: #131: the needs-you message has a Rebuild… button (the approver's, like Approve). Pressed by someone else it is refused and opens nothing; pressed by the approver it opens a form with the note "rebase on main and fix what CI shows", and submitting it as it is sends the item back to build with that note on the same PR.

messages.text: ^Sorry, only the approver can do that\.$

data.notes: ^rebase on main and fix what CI shows$

messages.text:
^\[Rebuild #[0-9]+\]
Sends #[0-9]+ back to build on its branch, with this note for the builder\.
Note for the builder: rebase on main and fix what CI shows
\[Rebuild\] \[Cancel\]$

^Sent back to build by you: 'rebase on main and fix what CI shows'\.$
